0022600188.text: The Heat (2-5, on a one-game losing streak) visit the Warriors (5-3, on a five-game winning streak) from 11th in the East and 4th in the Southeast, 2 games back, while Golden State sits 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, and 8th in the West. Golden State enters without Gui Santos (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), all listed as out. The teams have not met yet this season, after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the last meeting was on January 19, 2026, in San Francisco, when the Heat lost 135-112.
